overview: This batch focuses on finalizing the ultra-endgame state by implementing deterministic compression for the 5,500-tick simulation history and optimizing the Monte Carlo survival verification loop. The goal is to achieve 100% simulation coverage with minimal memory footprint and zero deadlocks, ensuring the 'Deep-Mantle' campaign concludes with a verified, reproducible state.

tasks.title: Implement Deterministic Bit-Packed State Compression for Tick History
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array<uint64_t, N> for fixed-size storage. Implement a custom bit-packer using constexpr functions. No dynamic allocation. Each tick state is compressed into a 64-bit word using field masks. Decompression uses bitwise shifts and masks. Ensure strict little-endian compatibility. Include static_asserts for size checks.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Compression ratio > 85% for 5,500 ticks. 2. Decompression is O(1) per tick. 3. Zero heap allocations during compression/decompression. 4. Unit tests verify bit-perfect reconstruction.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster load times for endgame saves; smoother scrubbing through the 5,500-tick history.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Survival Rate Verification Loop
tasks.architectural_spec: Refactor the verification loop to use a fixed-size circular buffer for intermediate states. Use std::span for view access. Implement a fast-path for the 100% survival rate check using early exit on first mismatch. Avoid virtual calls in the hot loop; use template specialization for the 16,500 footsteps log.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Verification completes in < 10ms for 5,500 ticks. 2. Memory usage remains constant regardless of tick count. 3. 100% survival rate confirmed without false positives.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Immediate feedback on simulation integrity; no lag when checking campaign completion status.

tasks.title: Generate Deterministic Endgame Summary from Compressed State
tasks.architectural_spec: Parse the compressed state from TASK-801. Extract key metrics (survival rate, footstep count, deadlock count) using direct index access. Format output using std::format (C++20). No intermediate string allocations; use a fixed-size char buffer for the summary.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Summary generated in < 1ms. 2. Output matches the 5,500 ticks / 0 deadlocks / 16,500 footsteps / 100% survival rate exactly. 3. No heap allocations.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant, clear, and accurate endgame report for the player.
